name: bicycle.guide — guide registry API
description: The published-guide registry (the control plane of the guide business), its taxonomy, and the capability spine joining books × guides × KSAO elements × jobs — read-only control-plane metadata for cooperating repos and agents. Shared-secret auth on every route (see securitySchemes). The same data is also servable, unauthenticated, over MCP at https://bicycle.guide/mcp. Full contract: https://bicycle.guide/docs (repo docs/GUIDE-REGISTRY-API.md).
